sloka: प्रग्Rहीत अन्जलिः किम्चित् तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रमन् ।यदा वक्तुम् स्वयम् दैन्यान् न शशाक मही पतिः ॥२-१४-६१॥
transliteration: pragRhīta anjaliḥ kimcit tasmāt deśāt apākraman ।yadā vaktum svayam dainyān na śaśāka mahī patiḥ ॥2-14-61॥

translations.english: When the king himself in that wretched state was not able to speak to Sumantra, crafty Kaikeyi said to him in reply:
